summary: Shell plc disclosed daily open-market repurchases of its ordinary shares for cancellation under the buy-back programme announced 30 July 2026. On 01 September 2026 it bought 485,995 shares on the LSE at a volume-weighted average of GBP 34.1397 and 387,620 shares on XAMS at EUR 39.9640; on 02 September 2026, 750,000 LSE shares at GBP 34.3977 and 300,000 XAMS shares at EUR 40.1730. Goldman Sachs International makes trading decisions independently through 23 October 2026 under UK Listing Rules and MAR. Watch execution pace, cancellation-driven share count reduction and buyback support for per-share metrics.
